Shared treatment questions

What is the difference between the weight loss program and microdosing?

Both use semaglutide or tirzepatide. Microdosing uses a lower dose for slower, gentler progress, and costs $179 every 4 weeks. The full program starts at $249.

Do I have to inject?

Not always. Semaglutide comes as a daily tablet, and NAD+ comes as a nasal spray or a liposomal taken by mouth. Injections come with written and video instructions.

Can I combine treatments?

Some patients add the B12 injection to a weight-management plan. Whether two treatments can be combined is your provider's decision.

Do I need a prescription?

Yes. A licensed provider reviews your intake and decides whether a treatment is right for you.
